name: Neon Baseball: Home Run Derby
summary:
Step into a futuristic night stadium and see how far you can send the ball in Neon Baseball: Home Run Derby, a fast, comfortable VR batting challenge built for Meta Quest.

Choose your left or right controller as the bat and face an automatic pitching machine serving fastballs, slow balls, curveballs and rising pitches. Time your swing, make solid contact and watch every hit fly into the neon outfield.

Every metre adds to your score. Clear the 42 m home-run fence for a major bonus, smash three glowing targ
